AgentDecisionEvent.description:
Muse Spark 1.3 after reading one observation: what it read, the follow-ups it requested (each citing an
observation, with its status) and the questions it left open.
AgentDecisionEvent.title: AgentDecisionEvent

AuditConditionValue.description:
One section under one assignment condition.

`molecules` counts the result's molecules in the population kept under the condition; retention divides it
by the default condition's count. Each excess drop is its expectation minus the observed value.

cells_expressing.description: Cells of the population that meet a presence measure under the condition (the observed value's numerator); null for the co-expression score.

pairs_scored.description: Co-expression score only: the marker pairs averaged.

AuditConditionValue.title: AuditConditionValue

AuditIndex.description: The committed audit results of a dataset, with the inputs they were computed from.

input_sha256.description: sha256 of each input artifact, by path.

section_disclosure.description: How many sections and donors the dataset holds; shown with every section count.

AuditIndex.title: AuditIndex

AuditIndexEntry.description: One committed audit result, as the findings table lists it.
AuditIndexEntry.title: AuditIndexEntry

AuditMetrics.description:
Retention and excluded molecules for one scope of a section under one assignment condition.

A scope is the whole section (cell_type and gene are null), one cell type (gene is null), or one gene
within one cell type. Retention is the share of default-condition molecules the condition keeps; it is
null, with a reason, when the scope has no default-condition molecules.
AuditMetrics.title: AuditMetrics

genes.description: One gene, a gene set (presence of any), or every gene of the scored marker pairs.

eligible_section_ids.description: Sections with at least 20 cells of the population and 10 of the result's molecules in them under the default condition; pooled values and the label use only these.

gene_pairs.description: Co-expression score only: the marker pairs it averages.

roi.description: The box the result is scoped to (a cell is inside when its centroid is, and brings all its molecules); null for a whole-section result.

AuditRules.description: The frozen analysis rules a result was computed under, recorded with it.

home_cell_types.description: Each gene's home cell type from the full-panel marker map; null when it has none.

AuditRules.title: AuditRules

AuditSectionValues.description:
One section of an audit result. `cells_labelled` is the fixed population count: cells carrying the
label under the default condition. A cell without retained molecules stays in every denominator.
`cells_with_retained_molecule` (per condition) counts population cells that keep at least one molecule of any
gene, reported separately from the fixed denominator.
AuditSectionValues.title: AuditSectionValues

BudgetExhaustedEvent.description:
The plan's tool-call budget is spent: the investigation drafts claims from the evidence it has and reports
what it could not settle.
BudgetExhaustedEvent.title: BudgetExhaustedEvent

CacheInput.description:
A computed input a model request was built from. Part of the cache key, so a changed tool version
or artifact invalidates the stored response.
CacheInput.title: CacheInput

CapabilityCheck.description: One analysis and whether this dataset supports it, with the reason.
CapabilityCheck.title: CapabilityCheck

CapabilityReport.description: For a dataset, which analyses are supported, unavailable or descriptive only, each with its reason.

contrasts.description: The inference eligibility of every contrast the dataset allows.

CapabilityReport.title: CapabilityReport

nucleus_radius.description: Radius of a circle with the nucleus's area: an approximation.

ChainCheckResult.description: The outcome of checking an audit log's hash chain. `first_bad_seq` is the first entry that fails.
ChainCheckResult.title: ChainCheckResult

ChannelSet.description: Every rendered channel of one section, in a fixed order.
ChannelSet.title: ChannelSet

reasons.description: Every problem the check found; empty when it passed.

CitedNumber.description: One number the claim's text uses, and the field of the cited finding it comes from.
CitedNumber.title: CitedNumber

direction.description: The direction the claim states, when it states one in structured form; else read from its text.

neighbour_pattern.description: The neighbour pattern the claim states, if any.

ClaimChallenge.description:
One recorded injected variant of a claim and its recorded verification. `detected` is the recorded outcome:
true when a check found a problem the original claim did not have (`new_reasons`), false for a miss.
ClaimChallenge.title: ClaimChallenge

ClaimChallenges.description: The "Challenge the verifier" options of one claim: its injected variants, named only by error kind.
ClaimChallenges.title: ClaimChallenges

ClaimControls.description: Ids of the controls the claim cites; a required control that is missing fails verification.
ClaimControls.title: ClaimControls

ClaimDraft.description: The claim-drafting model's structured output: the sentence and every number it uses.
ClaimDraft.title: ClaimDraft

ClaimRejectedEvent.description: A claim draft that failed validation even after one redraft. No claim is made from it.
ClaimRejectedEvent.title: ClaimRejectedEvent

ClaimVerifiedEvent.description:
A claim version after its three checks, with its verification status and every reason. An injected variant
carries `claim.injected.is_injected` and is always shown as injected.
ClaimVerifiedEvent.title: ClaimVerifiedEvent

CoMention.description: A deterministic count over the fetched records: how many mention every term group in title or abstract.
CoMention.title: CoMention

CompositeFigure.description:
An audit result's two-panel figure: A, per-section observed values against both expectations across
conditions; B, a 300 x 300 µm crop around its top-ranked evidence region.

path.description: PNG path relative to the dataset's artifact directory.

crop.description: Panel B's crop; null when the result has no evidence region.

CompositeFigure.title: CompositeFigure

ConditionEffect.description: The difference between group means of the log2 values under one condition (disease minus control).

valid.description: Every section of both groups passes the molecule gate under the condition.

ConditionEffect.title: ConditionEffect

ConditionName.description: An assignment condition: a rule that decides which molecules count toward a cell (ADR-0002).
ConditionName.title: ConditionName

Contrast.description: One disease group compared with the control group, for example DKD vs Control.
Contrast.title: Contrast

ContrastEligibility.description:
Whether one contrast's groups support statistical inference. In this release every contrast is
descriptive only, because GEO does not map sections to donors (ADR-0007). Donors are never inferred from
expression.

disease_donors_published.description: Donors in the disease group, from the paper's published counts.

control_donors_published.description: Donors in the control group, from the paper's published counts.

excluded_section_ids.description: Sections of either group left out of the contrast, each named with its reason in inference_reason.

ContrastEligibility.title: ContrastEligibility

ContrastIndex.description: The committed contrast results of a dataset, with their run configuration and inputs.
ContrastIndex.title: ContrastIndex

ContrastIndexEntry.description: One committed contrast result, as the findings table lists it.
ContrastIndexEntry.title: ContrastIndexEntry

donor_distinctness.description: From the capability report, for example counts_do_not_reconcile.

exploratory_per_section.description: The exploratory condition's values, on sections with structure masks only; never in the label (ADR-0006).

section_disclosure.description: How many sections and donors the dataset holds; shown with every section count.

ContrastRules.description: The frozen contrast rules a result was computed under, recorded with it.
ContrastRules.title: ContrastRules

ContrastRunConfiguration.description: What a contrast batch ran: the frozen rules, conditions and the (cell type, gene) grid, fixed before computing.

grid.description: [label rule, cell type, gene] per result, per contrast.

ContrastRunConfiguration.title: ContrastRunConfiguration

ContrastSection.description: One section of a contrast: its group and the fixed population count against the population gate.
ContrastSection.title: ContrastSection

answerable.description: No hard gap: a run on this workspace can address the question.

have.description: One sentence: what the workspace holds.

upload_needs.description: What the researcher's own sections must contain for this question.

related_recordings.description: Recorded questions on the same genes or cell types.

search_note.description: Which query returned the datasets, or why the search could not run.

hard.description: True when no run on this workspace can answer it (a gene off the panel, another organ, species or assay); false when a run would answer a nearby question instead.

DatasetFilters.description: The quality and panel filters every validated molecule passed.
DatasetFilters.title: DatasetFilters

DatasetManifest.description: Provenance of a dataset: where it came from, its files, panel and sections.

label_rule_ids.description: Frozen label rules; the first is the default.

DatasetManifest.title: DatasetManifest

DispatchProposal.description: The dispatcher's answer: the sub-agents to start, at most eight.

summary.description: One sentence on what the lab will do and why.

DispatchProposal.title: DispatchProposal

EventBase.description:
Fields every event carries. `seq` starts at 1 and increases by one per event within an
investigation; `recorded_at_utc` is when the event was first recorded and never changes on replay.
EventBase.title: EventBase

EvidenceRegion.description:
A region ranked by the result's ranking rule as showing the molecules behind it (rank 1 is first).
`score` is the ranking count: the result's molecules in the population excluded under `condition`.

default_molecules.description: The result's molecules in the population in the window under the default condition.

EvidenceRegion.title: EvidenceRegion

EvidenceStatus.description: An evidence label. It says what the evidence supports, never whether a finding is biologically true.
EvidenceStatus.title: EvidenceStatus

FieldChange.description: One field an injected error changed.
FieldChange.title: FieldChange

FindingRef.description: The one finding a claim cites.
FindingRef.title: FindingRef

FollowUpDecision.description: The agent model's structured output after reading one observation.

reading.description: What the agent reads in the observation, in one to three sentences.

requests.description: Follow-up tool calls; empty when the observation needs none.

open_questions.description: Questions the evidence leaves open that the registry's tools cannot answer.

FollowUpDecision.title: FollowUpDecision

FollowUpProposal.description: One follow-up tool call as the agent model proposes it, before it is checked against the registry.

cites_observation.description: The id of the observation that prompted this request, such as obs-1.

reason.description: Why this observation calls for this tool, in one or two sentences.

FollowUpProposal.title: FollowUpProposal

FollowUpRequest.description:
A follow-up request as the orchestrator recorded it: accepted (and run), rejected (with the reason) or over
budget (not run, and reported as an open question).

request_id.description: req-<n>, numbered in the order the agent made its requests.

FollowUpRequest.title: FollowUpRequest

GateStatus.description: Cells and molecules in a box against the frozen gates, fast enough to show while a box is dragged.

cells.description: Cells of the population whose centroid lies in the box.

molecules.description: Default-condition molecules of the genes assigned to those cells.

GateStatus.title: GateStatus

HypothesisVerdict.description: Every sub-claim's verdict, in the investigation's sections and under the controls its claims cite.
HypothesisVerdict.title: HypothesisVerdict

InjectedError.description: Whether this claim is a deliberately altered copy used to test verification. Always shown when true.
InjectedError.title: InjectedError

InvestigationSnapshot.description: The current state of one investigation, including every event emitted so far.

regions.description: Regions the researcher drew in the viewer, kept as context.

InvestigationSnapshot.title: InvestigationSnapshot

InvestigationState.description: state.json in the investigation's directory; events.jsonl beside it holds every event.

regions.description: Regions the researcher drew in the viewer, kept as context.

InvestigationState.title: InvestigationState

KpmpCellMap.description:
One participant's marker-positive cells, for drawing on the image: each cell's centroid and which of the audit
markers its whole-label mean reaches under the frozen thresholds. Positive for a marker, not a cell type: the masks
are nucleus-sized, so a label is the nucleus and a thin rim.

condition.description: The measurement condition the positivity is read under.

markers.description: Bit i of each cell's `positive` is markers[i].

total_cells.description: All cells in the participant's table, positive or not.

positive.description: Bitmask over `markers`; only cells positive for at least one are listed.

means.description: Per listed cell, its whole-label mean of each marker (0-255), rounded to 0.1.

KpmpCellMap.title: KpmpCellMap

display_max.description: The raw intensity shown at full brightness.

mask_coverage.description: Share of the image's pixels inside a segmentation label.

clinical.description: Clinical values from KPMP sources only (the atlas's enrollment category); empty when none was fetched.

KpmpTile.description: One display image of a channel: a horizontal strip of the participant's image, placed by its bounds (µm).

path.description: Under the artifacts directory; served at /api/kpmp/files/<path>.

KpmpTile.title: KpmpTile

LabReport.description:
The written analysis, assembled deterministically from the verdict, the claims, their controls and the lab's
artifacts. Next steps are suggestions, each tied to the artifact it comes from.
LabReport.title: LabReport

LabTaskProposal.description: One sub-agent the dispatcher asks for, about one sub-claim of the verdict.

sub_claim.description: Index of the sub-claim in the verdict, from 0.

reason.description: One sentence: why this sub-agent, for this sub-claim.

query.description: Required for a literature task: a Europe PMC query in boolean syntax, for example '(LRP2 OR megalin) AND podocyte AND human'. An empty string for every other agent.

LabTaskProposal.title: LabTaskProposal

LabelCounts.description: One section's cells counted by cell type label under each rule, and the cells whose label differs.

cell_types.description: Per label rule id, cells per cell type label.

differing.description: Cells per 'first-rule label -> second-rule label' change.

LabelCounts.title: LabelCounts

LabelRule.description: A frozen, named rule that assigns cell type labels from marker counts under the default condition.

markers.description: Marker genes per cell type, in tie-break order.

ignored_genes.description: Genes the rule never reads when it decides membership.

score_threshold.description: A cell's top marker score (count / gene scale) must reach this.

min_molecules.description: A cell with fewer default molecules is labelled 'Low quality'.

LabelRule.title: LabelRule

LabelRuleArm.description: The measure under one label rule.

cells_labelled.description: Cells of the population summed over every counted section.

LabelRuleArm.title: LabelRuleArm

LabelRuleSet.description: The frozen label rules of a dataset, the gene scales they use, and per-section label counts.

gene_scales.description: Mean default molecules of each gene per expressing cell, pooled over the scale sections.

LabelRuleSet.title: LabelRuleSet

cells_in_both.description: Cells labelled with the population under both rules.

same_label.description: Both rules give the same evidence label.

LeaveOneSectionOut.description: The effect recomputed without one section, and whether its direction survives.
LeaveOneSectionOut.title: LeaveOneSectionOut

LeaveOneSectionOutVerdict.description: The audit verdict with one eligible section left out: which stricter conditions fall below the threshold.

verdict.description: stable or segmentation_sensitive; null when an expectation is missing.

LeaveOneSectionOutVerdict.title: LeaveOneSectionOutVerdict

LeftOutSection.description: A section of the dataset the result does not count, with the reason (for example a duplicate).
LeftOutSection.title: LeftOutSection

LiteratureDigest.description: Muse Spark's reading of the fetched records about one sub-claim.

gap.description: One sentence: what these records do not address about the sub-claim.

LiteratureDigest.title: LiteratureDigest

LiteratureRecord.description: One record exactly as Europe PMC returned it (abstract cut to 1,500 characters).

record_id.description: 'PMID:<n>' when the record has a PubMed id, else '<source>:<id>'.

LiteratureRecord.title: LiteratureRecord

hit_count.description: Europe PMC's total hits for the query; only `records` were read.

statements.description: Statements that passed the citation check.

note.description: What the co-mention count supports, worded as a count, never as novelty.

text.description: One sentence about what the cited records report. No claim beyond them.

cites.description: record_id values of the records the sentence rests on; at least one.

MarkerPairsSource.description: The frozen exclusive-marker-pair artifact a result used, with the checksum of its file bytes.
MarkerPairsSource.title: MarkerPairsSource

ModeInfo.description: How the server answers questions. Live runs arrive with ticket 03.
ModeInfo.title: ModeInfo

ModelCallEvent.description:
Telemetry for one model call: provider, model, purpose, latency, tokens, estimated cost, whether the
response was live or stored, and the run mode. Never carries keys or prompt text.
ModelCallEvent.title: ModelCallEvent

ModelCallRecord.description:
One model call as the audit log records it and the telemetry pills show it, including whether its
response was live (`source: live`) or stored (`source: replay`).

estimated_cost_usd.description: Spend charged to the live budget; null for stored responses.

served_by.description: The provider that answered; differs from `provider` after failover.

error_code.description: Set when the call produced no usable response.

ModelCallRecord.title: ModelCallRecord

ModelRequest.description:
Everything sent to a provider. Its content hash keys the cache and the replay (ADR-0003),
so it must never contain ids, timestamps or other run-specific values.

max_tokens.description: Every model here reasons before answering; a small cap returns empty content.

keywords.description: Muse Voice Transcribe: terms to bias recognition toward, such as panel gene names. Left out of the cache key when empty, so requests stored before this field existed keep their keys.

ModelRequest.title: ModelRequest

ModelResponse.description:
What a provider returned. `finish_reason` is "length" when the token cap cut the answer short, on either
endpoint. `served_by` names the provider that answered when it differs from the requested one (failover).

events.description: SAM 3.1: the streamed response events, kept so a stored response is parsed exactly as a live one.

ModelResponse.title: ModelResponse

MoleculeColumns.description: One entry per molecule, column by column, so a whole section ships compactly.

cell_index.description: Index into the cell columns; -1 for an unassigned molecule.

included.description: Per condition, 1 if the molecule counts toward its cell under that condition, else 0.

MoleculeColumns.title: MoleculeColumns

NeedMatch.description: One thing the question names, and whether the workspace holds it.

value.description: What it was read as: an HGNC symbol, a cell-type label, a disease group, an organ, a species or an assay.

NeedMatch.title: NeedMatch

OpenQuestion.description:
Something the investigation could not settle: a follow-up the budget did not allow, an observation the agent
never read because the budget ran out, or a question the agent raised.
OpenQuestion.title: OpenQuestion

OutlineMeasures.description:
One candidate outline of a seed (the seed box, the convex hull of its NPHS1 clusters, or the SAM 3.1
outline) measured the same way, so what SAM adds over the cruder shapes is visible.

- `seed_box_coverage`: the share of the seed box's area the shape covers.
- `retention`: the structure-constrained condition with this shape as the only structure, over default
  molecules whose molecule or cell centroid lies inside it: the share kept.
- PECAM1 (endothelium) and PDGFRB (mesangium) consistency: each gene's molecule density inside the shape over
  its density in the rest of the seed's crop, and the share of the crop's molecules of the gene inside.
  Glomerular tufts carry both; neither gene seeded the box.
OutlineMeasures.title: OutlineMeasures

PackageInfo.description: What the UI needs to offer an evidence package for download.
PackageInfo.title: PackageInfo

PackageManifest.description: manifest.json inside the evidence package: what it contains and how it was produced.

open_questions.description: What the investigation could not settle within its budget.

PackageManifest.title: PackageManifest

PackedColumn.description: One column as a base64 string of little-endian values, decoded straight into a typed array.
PackedColumn.title: PackedColumn

PackedMoleculeColumns.description: Every molecule of the view, one typed column each.
PackedMoleculeColumns.title: PackedMoleculeColumns

PackedRegionView.description:
A region view in typed columns, compact enough to ship and draw a whole section of several hundred
thousand molecules at once.
PackedRegionView.title: PackedRegionView

Plan.description: The ordered tool steps proposed for a question; frozen once approved (its hash is then recorded).

plan_hash.description: sha256 of the proposed plan's canonical JSON, set at approval.

Plan.title: Plan

PlanProposal.description: The planner model's structured output, before it is checked against the tool registry.

sub_claims.description: The question split into testable sub-claims, each with the hypothesis's prediction.

PlanProposal.title: PlanProposal

PlanRejectedEvent.description:
A plan turned down. By the validator: it names a tool outside the registry, invalid arguments or an analysis
the capability report does not support; the planner gets one re-plan. By the researcher: the investigation ends
and nothing runs.

attempt.description: 1 for the first proposal, 2 for the re-plan.

tools.description: The tools the rejected proposal named.

PlanRejectedEvent.title: PlanRejectedEvent

PooledConditionValue.description: One condition pooled over the eligible sections, by the result's pooling rule (ratio of sums).

below_home_threshold.description: Observed below the home-matched expectation times 2^-0.5 (an excess log2 drop above 0.5).

PooledConditionValue.title: PooledConditionValue

Population.description: The cells a result is about: a cell type under a frozen label rule, fixed under the default condition.
Population.title: Population

ProteinAuditResult.description:
How the share of one marker's positive cells in a population behaves across measurement conditions, for one
participant, over the whole image or a region. One participant against another is descriptive only.

population.description: The population, frozen under the whole-cell condition, for example 'Podocalyxin+ cells'.

home.description: The marker's home cells, for example 'LRP2+ cells that are not Podocalyxin+'.

cell_table_checksum.description: sha256 of the per-cell table the result was computed from.

ProteinAuditResult.title: ProteinAuditResult

ProteinConditionRow.description: The result under one measurement condition. Population cells with no pixel kept count as not positive.

positive_cells.description: Population cells whose mean of the marker under this condition is at or above its threshold.

expected_share.description: Random-pixel-loss expectation: the mean over population cells of the probability that a random subset of the cell's pixels, as large as this condition keeps, has a mean at or above the threshold.

pixel_retention.description: Population pixels kept under this condition / population pixels of the whole cells.

excluded_cells.description: Population cells positive for the marker as whole cells but not under this condition.

retained_cells.description: Population cells positive for the marker as whole cells and under this condition.

bordering_home_share_excluded.description: Share of the excluded cells that border a home cell.

bordering_home_share_retained.description: Share of the retained cells that border a home cell.

ProteinConditionRow.title: ProteinConditionRow

ProteinThreshold.description: A frozen positivity threshold on a marker's per-cell mean intensity.

source_participant_id.description: The participant whose cells the threshold was derived from.

ProteinThreshold.title: ProteinThreshold

PublicDataset.description: One repository record, as returned. `technology` and `matches` are read from its title and summary by code.

auditable_here.description: Human Xenium output (GEO's taxon), which the Your data page audits as uploaded.

matches.description: Which of the question's needs the title or summary names.

PublicDataset.title: PublicDataset

sections.description: Every section's values; only eligible ones are pooled.

threshold.description: The frozen audit threshold the verdict uses.

RecordedBoxes.description:
Boxes on a section whose SAM 3.1 box-prompt response is stored, so a cached tool rerun can outline them
without a model call. Any other box needs a live run.
RecordedBoxes.title: RecordedBoxes

Recording.description: A recorded investigation's model responses, replayed by content hash of each request.
Recording.title: Recording

Region.description: A rectangular window of a section, in micrometres, that the viewer shows and a claim can point to.
Region.title: Region

RegionAuditRequest.description: A box the researcher drew on one RNA section, to audit one population and its genes inside it.
RegionAuditRequest.title: RegionAuditRequest

RegionView.description: Everything the viewer draws for one region of a section, in micrometres.
RegionView.title: RegionView

RenderedChannel.description: One channel of a section: which molecules (or nuclei) it draws, and whether the section has any.

genes.description: The genes whose molecules the channel draws; empty for the nuclei channel.

count.description: Molecules of the channel's genes in the section, assigned or not; for nuclei, cells with a detected nucleus.

missing_genes.description: The channel's genes with no molecule in the section.

RenderedChannel.title: RenderedChannel

ReplayInfo.description: What the replay banner shows about the recording being played.

origin.description: live: recorded from real model calls; hand_authored: written for tests without calling a model.

dataset_id.description: The dataset the recorded investigation ran on; the server's default when null.

ReplayInfo.title: ReplayInfo

ReviewDecidedEvent.description: The researcher's decision on one claim version, and the claim with its new review status.
ReviewDecidedEvent.title: ReviewDecidedEvent

ReviewDecision.description: The researcher's decision on one claim version; voice decisions need confirmation.
ReviewDecision.title: ReviewDecision

ReviewRequest.description: A review decision as the client sends it; the server adds the claim version, the time and the id.
ReviewRequest.title: ReviewRequest

SectionAudit.description: The output artifact of the `audit_section` tool.
SectionAudit.title: SectionAudit

extent.description: Bounding box in micrometres: x0, y0, x1, y1.

name.description: The section's name in its source, for example x2.

content_sha256.description: sha256 of the decompressed raw molecule and cell files.

duplicate_of.description: An earlier section whose raw files hold identical content; analyses count only the earlier one.

SectionLog2Value.description: One section's library-size-normalised value, log2(CP10K + 1), under one condition.

gene_molecules.description: Molecules of the gene in the population kept under the condition.

SectionLog2Value.title: SectionLog2Value

SectionValidation.description:
What validation did to one section's raw records. Nothing is dropped silently: every molecule read is
kept or counted under exactly one reason, in this order: malformed, duplicate, below quality, not in panel.

malformed_molecules.description: No gene, a non-finite position, quality or nucleus distance, or a nucleus flag other than 0 or 1.

duplicate_molecules.description: A repeated transcript id; the first record is kept.

below_quality.description: Quality score under the dataset's threshold.

not_in_panel.description: A control probe or codeword, not a panel gene.

unassigned_molecules.description: Kept molecules the instrument assigned to no cell.

unmatched_molecules.description: Kept molecules assigned to a cell id missing from the cells table; kept, counted as unassigned.

malformed_cells.description: No id, or a non-finite centroid or cell area.

duplicate_cells.description: A repeated cell id; the first record is kept.

cells_without_molecules.description: Kept cells with no kept molecule; they stay in every denominator.

cells_without_nucleus.description: Kept cells with no detected nucleus (empty nucleus_area).

SectionValidation.title: SectionValidation

dataset_id.description: The dataset to investigate; the server's default when omitted. A recording names its own.

regions.description: Regions the researcher drew in the dual-section viewer (one per section), kept with the investigation as context and shown beside its verdicts. Each must lie on a section of the investigated dataset. They do not scope the analysis or reach any model prompt. Ignored by immutable replay, which returns a recorded investigation.

StructureMask.description:
The outline of one structure in section coordinates (micrometres), as a closed polygon.

`source` says where the outline came from: drawn by construction in a synthetic fixture, or proposed
by SAM 3.1 from a box prompt (ADR-0005), which the UI must label as a proposal.

mask_version.description: SAM 3.1 outlines: the version of the finder's frozen rules.

run_id.description: SAM 3.1 outlines: the structure-finder run that proposed it.

seed_id.description: SAM 3.1 outlines: the seed box it was prompted with.

StructureMask.title: StructureMask

structure_id.description: The structure mask built from it; null when it is empty or rejected.

crop_index.description: The image it was sent in, by index into the run's crops.

StructureProposal.title: StructureProposal

StructureRun.description:
One run of the structure finder on one section: the images sent to SAM 3.1, what came back for every seed,
and the outlines kept. Exploratory (ADR-0006): the outlines feed only the structure-constrained condition,
which never enters an evidence label.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Live spend for a live run; for a stored run, what the same images cost at list price.

StructureRun.title: StructureRun

StructureSeed.description:
One box prompt: merged NPHS1 clusters (one per glomerulus, padded), or a box the researcher drew.
NPHS1 seeds the box, so it is never used to judge the outline.

nphs1_molecules.description: NPHS1 molecules in the merged clusters; null for a user box.

clusters_merged.description: NPHS1 clusters merged into this seed; null for a user box.

StructureSeed.title: StructureSeed

SubClaim.description:
One testable part of the question: a population, its genes, and what the hypothesis predicts under stricter
assignment conditions. A prediction, never an outcome.

text.description: The sub-claim as a question-scoped statement, for example 'podocyte LRP2/CUBN presence persists'.

cell_type.description: A cell type label from the dataset's label rules.

genes.description: Panel genes the sub-claim is about.

predicted.description: What the researcher's hypothesis predicts: 'holds' (the signal stays when assignment is stricter, as real cell content would) or 'drops' (it falls beyond random thinning, as admixture from neighbours would).

SubClaim.title: SubClaim

claim_ids.description: The verified claim versions the verdict rests on.

ToolFailedEvent.description: A tool call that raised instead of returning an artifact. The failure is itself an observation the agent reads.
ToolFailedEvent.title: ToolFailedEvent

label.description: The artifact's computed evidence label, when it has one.

ToolSpec.description: A tool as the planner sees it in the registry.
ToolSpec.title: ToolSpec

ToolStartedEvent.description: A tool call starting. A plan step has no request; a follow-up names its request and the observation it cites.

observation_id.description: The observation this call will produce.

reason.description: A plan step's rationale, or the agent's reason for a follow-up.

Transcription.description: What Muse Voice Transcribe heard. Nothing runs on it until the researcher confirms the edited text.

run_mode.description: `cached_tool_rerun` serves a stored response; `live` made a fresh call.

keywords.description: The panel genes recognition was biased toward.

audio_duration_ms.description: The clip's length, read from its WAV header.

VerdictEvent.description: Each sub-claim's verdict, derived by the frozen rule from the verified claims once verification ends.
VerdictEvent.title: VerdictEvent

VerificationResult.description: Every check run on one claim version, and the verification status they add up to.

figure.description: The composite figure the visual check read.

tolerances.description: The declared tolerances of the numerical check.

recomputed.description: Each cited source's independently recomputed value.

in_validated_summary.description: False for a failed claim: it stays in history only.

VerificationResult.title: VerificationResult

VisualAnswer.description: Muse Spark 1.3's reading of a composite figure, against this schema. A consistency check, not ground truth.

panel_a_direction.description: What Panel A shows: holds when the pooled observed line stays at or above the threshold line under every stricter condition, drops when it falls below it under at least one.

panel_a_matches_claim.description: Panel A's direction is the direction the claim states.

single_section_drives_panel_a.description: One section's line alone accounts for Panel A's pooled direction.

panel_b_matches_claim.description: Panel B, read with the computed neighbour-proximity shares, shows the neighbour pattern the claim states; null when the claim states none.

explanation.description: One or two sentences on what the panels show.
